notes.title: Fixing some bugs
notes.content:
Hi all,

We just pushed an update that should help alleviate the following issues:

- Cake pans not respawning when you use the flamethrower to cook a cake where the pans usually spawn.

- Cake orders failing because other cakes are too close to the finishing plate.

As always, let us know if any issues pop up!

Love, PD

notes.title: Would you like to voice a customer in the Batter Up! VR?
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We would like to reach out to everyone and let you know how to get your voice into the game as one of the many customers! 

A few Guidelines 
- No swearing or anything sexual, we would like to keep the game as kid-friendly as possible :)
- Nothing gender specific preferably

1 VOICE PACK = ALL OF THE FOLLOWING THINGS MUST BE SAID IN THE SAME VOICE

---

ALL VOICE LINES REQUIRED

Hello = When the customer walks into bakery

Goodbye = When the customer leaves the bakery

Eating = Chewing sound / Imagine getting squirt in the mouth with frosting

Mad = When the player takes too long on the order and the customer walks out.  The voice line triggers as soon as the order expires

onHit = Customer makes a sound when you throw something at them and it hits them

Order = Customer asks to order a cake (do not specify the kind of cake though, make it as generic as possible since it will be used for every order)

Thanks = When the player successfully fills the customers order, they should be thanked 

---

You can make as many voice packs as you want (as long as they're as different as possible)

Please know that if the recording is too low quality, we won't be able to put them into the game (as the difference in quality between recordings can affect immersion)

When you're finished, you can zip up all your files and email them with [Voice Pack] in the subject line to polygondustgames@gmail.com

notes.title: Improved Visuals and Counter Adjustments
notes.content:
Hi friends,

Another small update to Batter Up! today, here's what has changed:
- Added SSAO to give the game a bit more of a polished feel
- Updated the textures for our cakes, make 'em look a little less cylindrical
- Moved the bell and cake plate closer to the player (they were a bit close to the play bounds)
- Moved the play bounds forward to help with the above issue

We would love to hear your feedback :)

notes.title: Height adjuster added!
notes.content:
Our first patch has just gone out! This patch was to help players feel more comfortable with the height of the counters by adding a height adjuster in the main hub (as well as in the pause menu in-game)


[b]Other additions:[/b]
- Added a circle decal under the first dispenser to aid those who may be confused as to where to put the cake pan at first glance
